name: Happy Scribe
summary: Provides transcription services with support for multiple languages and automatic subtitle generation.
description:
Provides transcription services with support for multiple languages and automatic subtitle generation.

AI audio processing: Happy Scribe supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
